subject: kamala-harris

review.reviewer: Codex: distinct same-agent evidence review; no independent peer or human review claimed
review.notes: Separate pass reviewed all 240 literal statements, directions, intensity, educated assumptions, contradictions and metadata. All answers conservatively inferred; none are attributed as a submitted questionnaire. Reconsidered direct-national-vote mechanisms without treating absence as automatic opposition; rejected occupational inference for suspicionless searches; distinguished cultural inclusion from increased migration, cooperation from international sovereignty, publicly funded services from state ownership, tax credits from low redistribution, and inclusive rights from trait heritability. Checked changed 2024 healthcare/fracking positions, constitutional limits, targeted protection, market activity and safety regulation as counter-evidence. Neutral choices represent specified competing commitments. The preferred left match in the request was excluded from assessment criteria. Sources read in this pass are listed; failed initial Roll Call, TIME platform, AP and PDF URLs were not credited as fresh evidence. The successfully opened campaign PDF uses the www host and underscore filename. The campaign policy book is identified as September 2024, with date recorded undated because an exact release day was not verified. Ifri is later contextual analysis of the retained 2024 programme. All inferred IDs are separately listed in evidence-review.json. Portrait retained after Commons verification; religion supplement unchanged. Similarity reviewed after freezing the answer set. Review corrected fourteen excessively noncommittal answers: seven legal-migration/family/graduate/support mechanisms and seven ownership/provision mechanisms now use the most likely qualified agreement or disagreement rather than treating lack of an exact proposal as Neutral. Remaining neutrality is explicitly competing commitments, not uncertainty alone. Validation reports no errors and three neutral-count warnings: authority-liberty 5/16, protectionism-free-trade 8/16, culture-nature 7/16. Reviewed each against explicit competing commitments in its rationale; retained without automatic substitution. Closest diagnostic personality Hillary Clinton r4 is 92.7%, below 95%; no close-pair retention entry is required.

axisReviews.brief: Competitive elections, equal access and legislative checks are explicit commitments; direct national referendums are not established. Constitutional executive discretion is distinct from unchecked rule.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Voting legislation supports participation but does not establish signature-triggered national legislation, recall or expert sovereignty. September 2026 oversight remarks support checks, not a particular referendum mechanism.

axisReviews.brief: Constitutional expression, privacy and legal review coexist with regulated gun ownership, criminal enforcement and vaccination conditions. Safeguarded restrictions count towards Authority without implying Autocracy.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Prosecutorial experience does not establish support for suspicionless searches. Marijuana reform does not establish legalisation of every drug. Administration vaccination policy is contextual attribution. Nonviolent hatred is distinguished from threats and discriminatory conduct.

axisReviews.brief: Inclusive national membership and protected cultural identities coexist with shared civic participation. Multilingual voter access and Tribal recognition provide concrete examples.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: A shared American identity is emphasised. Recognition is not blanket priority for every cultural expectation. Religious covering exceptions and family identity priorities are not directly documented.

axisReviews.brief: Legal migration, family links and an earned citizenship route coexist with stronger border enforcement and asylum restrictions. The assessment distinguishes settlement rules from border rhetoric.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Her 2024 programme became more restrictive than earlier rhetoric. An earned pathway does not mean all unauthorised entrants may remain. Refugee protection is qualified by asylum eligibility and restrictive processing; cultural diversity is not itself an admissions criterion.

axisReviews.brief: Military superiority and allied defence coexist with diplomacy and a negotiated Gaza ceasefire. Neither alliances nor ceasefire advocacy alone settle this axis.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Gaza civilian protection and diplomacy qualify military resolve. Autonomous targeting is assessed through her AI legal-safety commitments; conscription, precise pre-emption and arms reductions are hypothetical.

axisReviews.brief: International alliances and common rules coexist with US constitutional sovereignty, currency and border control. Cooperation is not blanket transfer of national authority.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Previously expansive inferences about binding international authority are not established by support for cooperation. No documented support for a shared currency or political federation was found.

axisReviews.brief: Private enterprise is explicit; public funding and regulation do not automatically imply public ownership. Healthcare, housing and industry proposals retain a large private-provider role.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Earlier single-payer advocacy changed by 2024, and even single-payer funding would not establish public facility ownership. Public rail and strategic ownership exceptions qualify private preference. No comprehensive privatisation or nationalisation programme was found.

axisReviews.brief: Opposition to blanket tariffs coexists with domestic procurement, strategic manufacturing and screening of foreign control. Trade policy is selectively protective rather than uniformly open.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Criticism of across-the-board tariffs does not establish unilateral free trade or opposition to targeted safeguards. The 2024 US Steel ownership position supplies stronger strategic control evidence.

axisReviews.brief: Market production and competition coexist with industrial subsidies, minimum wages, targeted anti-gouging rules and regulation. Steering incentives is not compulsory production planning.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Price-gouging enforcement differs from setting every price. Rent-cartel action differs from general rent schedules. Support for independent monetary policy limits central-bank direction.

axisReviews.brief: Expanded family credits, worker supplements and progressive high-income taxes support substantial redistribution within a capitalist economy. Tax relief can itself be redistributive.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Tax protection below $400,000 and incentives to accumulate wealth qualify redistribution; her programme is not income equalisation or universal land reform. A billionaire minimum income tax is not a general tax on all wealth.

axisReviews.brief: Personal faith is compatible with civil law and reproductive choice independent of religious approval. The unscored religious identity supplement remains separate.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Faith leaders and religious ceremonies have a civic place in her rhetoric. Church tax status and religious holidays are not settled by abortion rights; the exact institutional scenarios remain inferred.

axisReviews.brief: Marriage equality, reproductive choice and transgender protections support substantial social change and equal recognition. Strength depends on documented commitment rather than an inferred left label.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Family belonging and inherited cultural practices remain valued. LGBTQ advocacy does not settle every classroom, pronoun or customary practice. Earlier professional conduct is not equated with later personal policy commitments.

axisReviews.brief: Accelerated housing and industrial technology coexist with AI testing, biomedical safeguards and environmental protection. The absence of long-term certainty does not mean automatic delay of every innovation.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Her AI speech explicitly rejects an innovation-versus-safety binary. Exact brain implants, cultivated meat and embryo enhancement are not documented. Public-benefit development remains bounded rather than disregarding environmental assessment.

axisReviews.brief: Federal rights and minimum economic standards coexist with state constitutions, local delivery and Tribal sovereignty. Federal supremacy within enumerated powers is not unilateral central authority over everything.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Rights-based overrides are narrower than overriding any inconvenient regional policy. Education, police and municipal governance remain decentralised. No documented general inter-state tax competition cap was found.

axisReviews.brief: Child-development investments, opportunity and discrimination concerns give substantial weight to social conditions. They do not establish a scientific comparative-causation belief for every trait.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: No explicit views were found on stress heritability, empathy, temperament, aesthetic preferences or national IQ causation. Neutral records interacting determinants and policy openness, not lack of research alone. Pay-gap wording does not cleanly measure biological Nature.
